collection_contracts.scope: one explicitly selected owned folder in the bound primary mailbox
collection_contracts.checkpoint: independent encrypted checkpoint after ADR-005 and G-STATE/G-PRIV
independent encrypted checkpoint only after its adapter ADR and state gates

collection_contracts.scope: no calendar collection until the least delegated contract and invitation correlation pass
collection_contracts.checkpoint: independent encrypted checkpoint only after ADR-005 ADR-006 G-CAL G-STATE and G-PRIV

checkpoint_contract.cardinality: one independent record per bound account and selected collection
checkpoint_contract.binding: account_ref collection_locator endpoint API version exact selected fields initial window or filter immutable-id preference schema version and policy version
checkpoint_contract.continuation: opaque encrypted full nextLink or deltaLink; never parse for business data reconstruct edit append export or reuse across a binding
checkpoint_contract.binding_drift: delete only the affected checkpoint and require visible bounded rebaseline

poll_policy.single_flight: exactly one active poll or reconciliation job per account and collection
poll_policy.cadence_status: internal validation target until measured G-MAIL load evidence passes
poll_policy.schedule_basis: start_to_start with no overlap; throttling and offline states delay the next start
poll_policy.background_boundary: per-user companion while the user is logged in; no coverage claim while stopped sleeping signed out offline unauthenticated or throttled

cycle_budgets.status: finite exact values pending measured G-MAIL experiments
cycle_budgets.stop_rule: stop at the first reached bound; retain encrypted continuation state; resume in a later non-overlapping cycle
cycle_budgets.priority: incremental continuation before bounded rescan; no tight loop or overlapping continuation
cycle_budgets.scope_bound: configured folder and visible history window only; never enumerate the mailbox root as a substitute

delta_protocol.initial_query: ADR-006 defines the selected-field and immutable-id request contract; execution remains blocked on G-MAIL
delta_protocol.continuations: follow the exact same-origin nextLink supplied by Graph; never reconstruct or add query parameters
delta_protocol.completion: deltaLink marks a completed round only after every page item has a durable safe outcome; last_complete_at updates only at that committed deltaLink
delta_protocol.ordering_assumption: none across pages retries or reconciliation
delta_protocol.tombstones: process as source availability change; never infer loop closure or Microsoft artifact deletion
delta_protocol.cursor_invalid: mark resync visible; discard only the affected checkpoint; bounded review-only rescan the same selected folder and history window
delta_protocol.cursor_invalid_trigger: exact status and error signature pending G-MAIL; all other auth account scope folder and query errors fail closed without resync

steps: stage encrypted continuation and keyed source-version observation keys
deduplicate every item within the bound account collection and policy version
apply eligibility without treating isRead or sent-copy observation as proof of review or delivery
fetch only the exact G-MAIL and ADR-006 field contract transiently
persist only an ADR-PRIV-001-approved safe outcome or recoverable quarantine record
atomically commit page outcomes before replacing the durable collection checkpoint
page_transaction.crash_rule: a crash before atomic commit replays the page; source-version idempotency prevents duplicate transitions or mutations
page_transaction.whole_page_failure: transport parse or schema failure blocks checkpoint replacement because no safe per-item disposition exists
page_transaction.cursor_advance_rule: prohibited until every page item is durable and safe

initial_or_backfill.incoming_already_read: analyze into one noninterruptive history-review batch
initial_or_backfill.incoming_unread: record the unread observation and wait for a later read observation after the baseline

post_baseline_incoming.observed_unread_then_read: analyze once when the later observation establishes unread-to-read
post_baseline_incoming.first_observed_already_read: analyze once with first-observation marker because polling may have coalesced states
post_baseline_incoming.first_observed_unread: wait for a later read observation
post_baseline_incoming.isRead_meaning: trigger only; never evidence of careful review

eligibility_policy.idempotency: purpose-separated keyed digest of bound account tested locator observed version and policy version

reconciliation_policy.frequency: periodic finite cadence pending measured G-MAIL experiments; also after stale recovery validated cursor reset rollback recovery configured query change or explicit user request
reconciliation_policy.bounds: same selected folders 1-to-365-day visible history window and per-cycle page item and elapsed bounds
reconciliation_policy.folder_rename: do not infer identity from a display name; continue only if the tested opaque folder locator remains valid
reconciliation_policy.folder_missing_or_deleted: stop that collection delete its application-owned checkpoint disclose coverage loss and require explicit remap; never auto-follow another folder
reconciliation_policy.move_between_folders: ADR-006 makes folder context non-identity; preserve identity across a same-mailbox move only after the G-MAIL matrix validates the immutable locator
known_unrecoverable: an item that enters is read and leaves selected scope between observations
a sent copy not saved or moved or deleted before observation
send-as on-behalf-of and alternate sent-folder behavior not proven by G-MAIL
time outside the configured history window

retry_policy.retry_after: honor a valid Graph Retry-After and make no request before it expires
retry_policy.missing_or_invalid_retry_after: bounded exponential backoff with positive jitter and finite cap; exact values pending measured G-MAIL experiments
retry_policy.automatic_attempts_per_item_generation: finite exact value pending G-MAIL; exhaustion enters recoverable quarantine rather than discard

quarantine_policy.before_cursor_advance: persist one validated recoverable record or keep the cursor blocked
quarantine_policy.locator_protection: validated encrypted locator under ADR-005; never plaintext log diagnostic fixture or package
quarantine_policy.dismiss_semantics: ends only that analysis job; never closes or deletes a loop or Microsoft artifact
quarantine_policy.resolution_cleanup: retry success dismissal or recovery atomically deletes the related job_health record before returning message_observation to ordinary retention; no quarantine_ref may dangle
quarantine_policy.disconnect_cleanup: atomically delete local message_observation and related job_health regardless of age; zero Graph mutation

replay_policy.bounds: explicit user-visible selected scope and 1-to-365-day history window under cycle budgets
replay_policy.idempotency: reuse the same bound source-version and transition keys
replay_policy.presentation: newly detected historical results enter a review batch

privacy_boundary.content_processing: transient only after G-MAIL and exact ADR-006 fields
